description: Provider-facing completion submission for the broad ExecPlan implementation pass. Scherzo independently verifies changed-file and diff evidence.

ready_for_verification.description: True only when all required plan scope is implemented and ready for semantic verification.

changed_files.description: Complete repository-relative changed-file evidence from the current implementation workspace.

remaining_required_work.description: Concrete required plan work that remains; empty only when the semantic verifier should pass.

blockers.description: Explicit conflicts or blockers that prevent completion; empty when unblocked.
